answers.ask: Tell me about American Swedish Historical Museum and whether it fits my wedding
answers.text: The American Swedish Historical Museum in Philadelphia fits 150 guests, since it seats up to 230. It's all-inclusive, so catering is handled in-house with Jeffrey A. Miller Catering as its preferred vendor, and it has an outdoor ceremony space. Google rates it 4.7 from 101 reviews, covering the whole place. The one wedding review praises the grounds and attentive staff. Forever unlocks the exact prices in every PDF and here.
